entries.en: The commander is right. We cannot rush off blind. We still need to learn more about Saren.
The commander's right. We can't rush off blind. We need more to go on.
What about Liara T'Soni? The Matriarch's daughter? Isn't she some kind of expert on the Protheans?
There's another asari. The Matriarch's daughter. Liara T'soni.
Yeah, right. Her mother was working for Saren. I bet she is, too.
Benezia helped us in the end. Maybe Liara will, too. At the very least, we should head for the Artemis Tau cluster to find her.
Who put you in charge? Did the commander resign when I wasn't looking?
Forgive me, Commander. I was only trying to help.
Of course, Shepard. I was only trying to help.
Noveria report is away, Commander. You want me to patch you through to the Council?
Crew... dismissed! Joker, alert the Council. Tell them everything.
The Mu Relay could link to dozens of systems. Unless we know exactly where Saren's going, we'd just be wasting our time.
We're all on the same team here, Williams. She's just trying to help.
I won't be a puppet for the asari! I give the orders around here. Understood?
I give the orders around here. I'll decide where we go next. Is that clear?
This is a tough mission. We're all on edge. Everyone go get some rest. Crew... dismissed!
Crew... dismissed.
We're done here. Crew... dismissed!
Time to end this!
Let's do it.
Not so fast.
There's no point.
I'm still in charge here!
I'm still in charge.
Fall out.
Don't let it happen again.
Commander. Do not cut me off like last time. I fail to find it amusing.
And we're out.
Is this report accurate, Commander? You found rachni on Noveria?
Found them and wiped them out! Do you take pleasure from committing genocide, Shepard?
Commander! You are addressing a member of the Council. You will show the proper respect!
We made you a Spectre. There is no greater form of respect.
This arguing is pointless. Commander, we have your report. Let us know if anything further develops.
And then released the queen! Do you have any idea what you've done? How many generations until they overrun the galaxy?
This is no joke, Commander! The rachni were one of the greatest threats the galaxy ever faced.
I hope you're right, Shepard. Our children's children will pay the price if you're not.
The mission must always come first. Just be aware that your actions can have far-reaching consequences.
We'll be waiting for your next report, Commander.
Let's just stick to business.
Save the sermon. I'm just here to follow up on my report.
Whoops.
It was them or me, Councilor. The choice wasn't hard.
Depends on the species... turian.
Respect works both ways.
Three? No-- four!
This queen is different. She understands why her kind had to be wiped out last time around.
All I care about is stopping Saren. The rachni don't matter.
Don't lecture me.
It was the only way.
Sometimes.
You haven't shown me any.
Let me do my job!
Should I guess?
They won't.
Not these ones.
Commander Shepard. I'm pleased to see your mission on Virmire was a success.
Saren is formidable enough without an army of krogan serving under him.
Yes, we saw mention of this on your report. Sovereign. A sentient machine. A true artificial intelligence. This news is quite alarming... if it turns out to be accurate.
He's playing you, Shepard! Saren still has contacts on the Citadel. He probably saw your earlier reports. The ones talking about your vision. And the Reapers.
It's highly possible Saren is using false information to throw you off balance. Our own intelligence has never turned up any corroborating information.
I believe you humans have a saying: even a broken clock is right twice a day.
Maybe we were wrong about you, Shepard. Maybe humans are too hot-headed to be Spectres.
Enough! Commander Shepard has performed admirably so far. This... discussion... is only a minor disagreement.
Try to see this from our perspective, Commander. Saren is a threat we can recognize. However, as far as we know, the Reapers only exist in your visions.
Our decisions affect trillions of lives. We cannot act on the accusations of a single person. Even a Spectre. Not without solid evidence.
The Council cannot take any official action here. That is why we created the Spectres. You have the authority to act as you see fit.
If you truly believe Sovereign is the real threat, you must take whatever steps are necessary to stop it. And Saren.
Good luck, Commander. From all of us.
Sovereign's the real problem here. The Reapers wiped out the Protheans. We're next.
The krogan would have served Sovereign. A Reaper.
Sovereign's a Reaper. Saren admitted it.
Sovereign's real. The Reapers are real. Saren even admitted it!
I tried to warn you about Saren. You didn't believe me then, and look how that turned out.
Here's another saying: go to hell!
Sooner or later you're going to have to take something I say on faith, Councilor.
The krogan don't matter.
Saren's not in charge.
It's accurate.
You don't believe me?
Screw you!
You need proof?
Aww. Looks like we lost the signal, Joker.
We've got bigger problems.
You have to believe me!
Disconnect.
I hope you don't plan to cut us off like last time, Commander. What you discovered on Virmire is too important.
We seem to have a lot of disagreements, Councilor.
You have to trust me.
This is getting old.
I think it's about time we told the commander what's really going on.
We're making a covert pick-up on Eden Prime. That's why we needed the stealth systems operational.
A research team on Eden Prime unearthed some kind of beacon during an excavation. It was Prothean.
Obviously, this goes beyond mere human interests, Commander. This discovery could affect every species in Council space.
I'm always expecting trouble.
Unless something goes wrong.
I need to see your skills for myself, Commander. Eden Prime will be the first of several missions together.
You'll be in charge of the ground team. Secure the beacon and get it onto the ship ASAP. Nihlus will accompany you to observe the mission.
It's a peaceful farming world, but it represents something much bigger. Eden Prime is one of our oldest and most successful colonies.
It proved we were ready to face the challenges of settling new worlds, to forge a place for humanity beyond Earth.
This is big, Shepard. The last time humanity made a discovery like this, it jumped our technology forward two hundred years.
You humans don't have the best reputation. Some species see you as selfish. Too unpredictable. Too independent. Even dangerous.
Sharing that beacon will improve relations with the Council. Plus, we need their scientific expertise. They know more about the Protheans than we do.
Just what they taught us in school. They were a technologically-advanced species that ruled the galaxy 50,000 years ago. Then they vanished.
Their Citadel is the very heart of galactic society. And without their mass relays, interstellar travel would be impossible. We all owe the Protheans a great debt.
The Attican Traverse isn't the most stable sector of Citadel space. There are plenty of raiders and criminal groups active in the region.
They might figure a Prothean beacon is worth the risk of attacking an Alliance ship. Plus, Eden Prime is right on the border of the Terminus Systems.
Technically, yes. But some of the species in the Terminus might be willing to start a war over this.
The last thing the Council wants is to get dragged into a major conflict with the Terminus Systems. We have to keep this low-key.
We should be getting close to Eden--
Is someone going to fill me in, Captain?
I don't like being kept in the dark, Captain.
There must be a reason you didn't tell me about this, sir.
What's the payload, Captain?
I thought the Protheans vanished 50,000 years ago.
Are we expecting trouble?
We can handle this on our own.
Why didn't we keep the beacon for ourselves?
Why is this beacon so important?
The Attican Traverse is under Citadel protection. If the Terminus Systems attack, it's an act of war.
What do you know about the Protheans?
I'd like to know more about Eden Prime before we touch down.
Just give the word, Captain.
Why the secrecy?
What are we picking up?
Prothean?
You sound worried.
We don't need your help here.
I'm ready to go.
Why did we tell the Council?
The Terminus Systems?
It never hurts to have a few extra hands on board.
I'm glad you're here to help.
This comes down from the top, Commander. Information strictly on a need-to-know basis.
There's more, Shepard. Nihlus isn't just here for the beacon. He's also here to evaluate you.
You're smart enough to know how things work, Commander.
The Alliance has been pushing for this for a long time. Humanity wants a larger role in shaping interstellar policy. We want more say with the Citadel Council.
That's why I put your name forward as a candidate for the Spectres.
This isn't about you, Shepard. Humanity needs this. We're counting on you.
Earth needs this, Shepard. We're counting on you.
Since when do we answer to the Spectres?
Guess that explains why I bump into him every time I turn around.
What's going on, Captain?
I don't like people making decisions about my future.
I assume this is good for the Alliance.
Just tell me what I have to do.
Like hell he is!
I should've known.
What if I refuse?
You support this, Captain?
What's the next step?
